jobs.label: Face
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE full-body 2D isometric tactical RPG sprite of the EXACT SAME male Ryuu shown in the reference image. This is another direction of one character's eight-way turn-around, NOT a redesign. Keep precisely his expressive hand-inked cel-shaded 2D style, same head/body ratio, oversized mint sage spiky hair, amber eyes, warm peach skin, patterned plum bandana and two long violet cloth tails tied behind his head, open dark plum short vest with high collar, leather shoulder pieces and bracers with gold angular fittings, diagonal brown waist belts and gold diamond buckle/pendant, baggy plum pants with angular golden motifs, wine-red asymmetric hip sash, plum calf ties and open-toe plum sandals. Preserve all asymmetries on the same anatomical sides while turning him. The red hip sash is attached on his anatomical LEFT hip (image right in the front reference); keep it there. No new cape, sword, backpack or armor. Relaxed standing idle stance, arms down lightly bent, hands loose, same stance and proportions. Crisp warm dark outlines, large grouped color areas, delicate internal linework, cel shading with restrained painted accents. Camera orthographic, elevated about 30 degrees looking down, soles remain on one level. Warm upper-left screen-space light, soft shading consistent with reference.
Technical: square 1254x1254 image, figure centered horizontally occupying about 90% height, clear 5% margins around ALL hair ribbons and feet, nothing cropped. Exactly one isolated character, NO labels, text, borders, floor, tile, cast shadow, checkerboard, other views or UI. Background must be perfectly flat bright chroma green #00FF00 for deterministic extraction. Green belongs ONLY to the background; hair remains PALE DESATURATED sage as reference, not vivid green.

VIEW REQUIREMENT (highest priority): FRONT view: character faces directly toward the camera / screen bottom (south). His face, chest, belly and belt buckle are centered and fully visible. Both eyes, ears, shoulders, hands and knees visible. NO three-quarter angle. We look slightly down on the top of his head and feet.
